detail: 3-run series, per-run comparisons ['AGREE', 'AGREE', 'AGREE'], 0 VulkanExecutionProvider fused-island execution(s) across 3 consecutive run(s) of one session = 0 island(s) per run. This counts ISLAND EXECUTIONS, not graph nodes: Phi-3.5 fuses 355 of 363 graph nodes into one island, so 3 run(s) of a healthy session report exactly 3. A reader who takes this for a graph-node count will read a catastrophe where the record says success.

output_coverage.means: CPU-ONLY is a refusal and is sound: no upstream node is ours. EP-COVERED is the weaker inference and only ever withholds MATCH, never grants it. Without a claim log the EP-COVERED side is nearly uninformative on a real model, because ORT's own optimisers delete node events wholesale.
